name: epoch_own
title: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub (ECI benchmark table): the 15 columns from Epoch's own files
selection: columns whose benchmarks[*].source_file is not an *_external.csv file; rows with >= 1 observed cell in them

source.revision: unversioned living dataset; snapshot pinned by sha256 (plus HTTP ETag and zip-member generation time)

headers.txt.role: HTTP response headers of the fetch (curl -D); source of etag/http_date

fetched_at.txt.role: UTC fetch timestamp (date -u); source of fetched_at

source.citation: Epoch AI, 'Capabilities & benchmarking'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from 'https://epoch.ai/benchmarks' [online resource].

value_definition: processed_data_for_eci.csv 'performance' = max(0, (max_r s_r - random_baseline) / (score_ceiling - random_baseline)), with s_r = row[score_column] * scale and the max over all raw rows of the benchmark whose model_version belongs to the group (i.e. best variant / agent / run).  In [0, 1]; higher is better.  Raw score of the best row: cells.raw_score (units of score_column*scale).
missing_definition: no row in Epoch's processed ECI table (O = 0, B = 0, empty in the CSV)

cells.source_model_version_note: model_version of the raw-CSV row attaining the max score (ties: model_version, then row id); only cells reproduced from raw are filled
cells.processed_model_version_note: 'model_version' column of processed_data_for_eci.csv, as given by Epoch, for every observed cell.  It is a label of the group, not necessarily the version attaining the max: it differs from source_model_version in 211 of 2927 reproduced cells
cells.source_note: 'source' column of processed_data_for_eci.csv: the report / leaderboard behind the value.  Given for 1655 of 2987 cells (74 distinct); cells without a source are omitted
cells.cost_token_note: values copied from the raw row that attains the cell's max score (ties: model_version, then row id); units and scope (per task / per run / total) as named by the source column; only cells reproduced from raw are filled
